release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.7.8 (Build 71): Impeccable Craft & Frontend Polish Update.
• Legal & Compliance Polish: Resolved text collision between label and web links with clean stacked hierarchy and external link icons.
• Material 3 Touch Targets: Expanded all header icons, back buttons, and auth visibility toggles to the 48x48dp accessibility standard.
• Android System Back Defense: Hardware back button now gracefully prompts or steps back to topic selection during active exams instead of abruptly exiting the app.
• Focus Trapping: Enabled accessibilityViewIsModal on Master PIN, Emergency Vault, and Guardian Disconnect dialogs to isolate screen reader focus.
• Performance Polish: Added tabular numerals across timer counters and score badges to eliminate live ticking jitter.
